name: segmented-control
description: Single- or multi-select segmented control for view and filter switches.
designIntent: Filters such as All / Investors / Advisors are often built with Tabs, which wrongly promises tabpanels. SegmentedControl provides radio semantics for single choice and pressed buttons for multi-select, with arrow-key navigation.

props.name: options
props.description: Segments to render: value, label, optional icon and disabled.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selection. Use string[] when multiple.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow more than one segment to be active.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch segments to fill the container width.

examples.title: Single-select audience filter
examples.code:
<SegmentedControl
  aria-label="Audience"
  value={audience}
  onValueChange={setAudience}
  options={[
    { value: 'investors', label: 'Investors' },
    { value: 'advisors', label: 'Advisors' },
    { value: 'owners', label: 'Owners' },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: Multi-select filter
examples.code:
<SegmentedControl
  aria-label="Deal type"
  multiple
  defaultValue={['m&a']}
  options={[
    { value: 'm&a', label: 'M&A' },
    { value: 'debt', label: 'Debt' },
  ]}
/>

antiPatterns.title: Don't use it for tab panels
antiPatterns.explanation: If each segment reveals its own panel, use Tabs so aria-controls and tabpanel semantics are correct.

antiPatterns.title: Don't omit the accessible name
antiPatterns.explanation: A radiogroup without a name is ambiguous. Pass aria-label or aria-labelledby.

accessibility.implementation: Uses role=radiogroup and role=radio with aria-checked and roving tabindex
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide an accessible name with aria-label or aria-labelledby

accessibility.implementation: Arrow keys move selection; Home and End jump to the first and last enabled segment
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep labels short enough to scan

accessibility.implementation: Uses role=group with aria-pressed on each segment
accessibility.userRequirements: Use multiple only when choices are independent

compositionRules.relationship: Pair a multi-select control with FilterChips to show and remove active filters
Use Tabs when each option owns a tabpanel; use SegmentedControl for filters
